description: Source code implementing IPC backend for Nordic nRF 802.154 spinel protocol, including IPC setup, ring buffer management, and packet sending thread.

methods.name: endpoint_bound
methods.description: Callback invoked when IPC endpoint is bound, releases semaphore.

methods.name: endpoint_received
methods.description: Callback invoked when IPC message is received, processes the packet.

methods.name: nrf_802154_backend_init
methods.description: Initializes IPC service, registers endpoint, and waits for binding.

methods.name: spinel_packet_from_thread_send
methods.description: Queues packet for sending from thread context, manages ring buffer.

methods.name: spinel_packet_send_thread_fn
methods.description: Thread function that sends queued packets via IPC.

methods.name: nrf_802154_spinel_encoded_packet_send
methods.description: Sends encoded packet, either directly or from ISR context.
